messages:
Lee (Customer-Security): Hi team — for the POC our security review needs concrete logging proof points: SIEM ingestion examples, immutable retention policy (WORM), admin action audit samples (who changed model pins/config), and a reproducible export with tamper-evidence for legal e-discovery. Can we get items to review by next week?

Sam (SalesEng): Yes — we can assemble a compact evidence bundle. Quick clarifying Q: POC retention window requested?

Lee (Customer-Security): POC: 24 months for user events, 84 months for admin/audit, plus WORM for 90 days. Also need details on deletion audits and how we show attempted deletes were blocked.

Alex (AE): Plan: 1) provide sanitized admin_activity log (JSONL), 2) SIEM ingest examples (Splunk HEC + Elastic filebeat + S3 JSONL), 3) sample export bundle with manifest and signature, 4) snippet for S3 Object Lock + lifecycle. Will that cover it?

Lee (Customer-Security): That sounds good. Also need proof of append-only audit (HMAC chain or similar) and how to verify it offline.

Maria (Solutions): I'll prepare the artifacts. Posting a redacted admin log example and export manifest below.

Maria (Solutions): ```
# redacted admin audit (JSONL)
{"ts":"2026-03-05T09:21:12Z","actor":"***@redacted.co","action":"model.pin","target":"model:open-psg-7b","req_id":"r_0x9a7","src_ip":"3.121.45.6","note":"pinned for canary"}
```

Maria (Solutions): sample export manifest (sanitized):
```
{"export_id":"exp_20260305_07","created_at":"2026-03-05T09:25:00Z","created_by":"ops@redwood.ai","files":[{"name":"admin-20260305.jsonl","sha256":"9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015"}],"signature":"sig_v1:BASE64_SIG","kms_key_id":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd"}
```

Maria (Solutions): Verification steps we'll include: 1) download bundle, 2) recompute SHA256 for each file, 3) verify manifest signature using Redwood public cert (we'll include), 4) confirm export_id exists in the append-only audit stream.

Jordan (CISO): Who holds the public cert? We need to validate signature without contacting Redwood services during audit. Also, confirm whether you publish the audit stream HMAC chain to the manifest.

Sam (SalesEng): We can provide a signed public cert and a downloadable verification tool (small script) that takes bundle and manifest and verifies hashes and signature offline. The audit stream includes an HMAC chain field (prev_hash) per entry; we can show how to recompute chain and verify integrity.

Maria (Solutions): Example HMAC-linked entry (sanitized):
```
{"i":12345,"ts":"2026-03-05T09:21:12Z","actor":"***@redacted.co","action":"model.pin","sha256":"9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015","prev":"b1946ac92492d2347c6235b4d2611184"}
```

Maria (Solutions): And sample verification command: `python verify_export.py --bundle export.tar.gz --manifest manifest.json --pubkey redwood_pub.pem`

redwood-deploy-bot: export queued: job=exp_20260305_07 status=started

Alex (AE): I'll attach a short playbook that covers Splunk HEC config, Filebeat input examples for Elastic, S3 ingestion patterns, and a checklist for the security reviewers (includes HMAC verification and manifest checks).

Lee (Customer-Security): Please include explicit guidance for: 1) Splunk HEC token setup, 2) S3 lifecycle + Object Lock JSON snippet, and 3) evidence that deletion attempts generate an alert and an audit record.

Maria (Solutions): S3 Object Lock snippet we'll include (example):
```json
{"ObjectLockEnabled":"Enabled","Rule":{"Status":"Enabled","Expiration":{"Days":90}}}
```

Maria (Solutions): Deletion attempts: console and API deletion are blocked by governance mode for WORM; attempted deletes create a retention-bypass request entry which is recorded in the audit stream and sent to the security webhook (we'll include sample webhook payload).

Jordan (CISO): Also add how exports are time-stamped and the manifest signed by KMS with the key id recorded in the manifest for auditors to cross-check.

Sam (SalesEng): Good point — we'll include the KMS key ARN in the manifest and a short description of the signing process.

redwood-deploy-bot: export job completed: job=exp_20260305_07 status=completed url=https://s3.redwood/exports/exp_20260305_07.tar.gz

Maria (Solutions): Artifacts ETA: Thursday EOD PT. I'll post the S3 links (sanitized) and the verification script in this channel when ready.

Alex (AE): Scheduling a 30-minute security handoff call for Friday; calendar invite incoming.

Lee (Customer-Security): Thanks — once we inspect the bundle we'll give feedback. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Sam (SalesEng): Thanks team :thumbsup:
